source_name: OTR Integrated Tax System (ITS) Public Extract — Open Data DC
verification_note: URL appeared verbatim in search results for 'Integrated Tax System Public Extract opendata.dc.gov'; also listed on data.gov catalog.
data_format: CSV, GeoJSON, Shapefile, KML, ArcGIS GeoService (Hub dataset)
update_frequency: weekly (Common Ownership Lots layer regenerated weekly from latest Public Extract per DC GIS metadata)
terms_notes: Open Data DC standard open license; no login. Related subsets: ITSPE Facts (cleaner column names), ITSPE Vacant Property, ITSPE Vacant and Blighted, ITSPE Property Sales.
difficulty_reason: Official open-data bulk file + ArcGIS API, clean terms.
notes: The ITSPE is the tax assessment roll: ownership, mailing address, assessed value, billing for 200k+ record lots, tax lots, parcels, condos, federal lands, keyed by SSL (Square-Suffix-Lot). ASSESSMENT FACTS: DC assesses at 100% of estimated market value; ANNUAL reassessment cycle (moved from triennial groups to annual assessments as of TY2002); notices mailed late February each year (otr.cfo.dc.gov assessment-process page). DC is unitary — no counties.

data_format: HTML
terms_notes: Public search, no login. Assessment/appeal detail also on MyTax.DC.gov.
difficulty_reason: Simple official web lookup; use ITSPE bulk file for anything programmatic.
notes: Per-parcel assessment, owner, sales history lookup by SSL or address. OTR also runs a Real Property Assessment 'Mapplication' GIS viewer (assessment neighborhoods/sub-areas): otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/real-property-geographic-information-systems-gis-program.

source_name: OTR Real Property Public Extract Records (mortgage-servicer bulk feed)

notes: Documents that the public extract covers 200,000+ parcels with location, size, usage, value, assessment, billing.

source_name: DC Recorder of Deeds Official Records Search (publicsearch.us)
verification_note: URL appeared verbatim in search results ('Official Records Search').
data_format: HTML index + document images (PDF/TIFF viewer)
cost: free to search/view after registration; $4.00/document download + $1.50 transaction surcharge; certified copies $2.25/page + $2.25 certification
terms_notes: FREE registration/login wall to search index and view images (Aug 1921–present). Download fees apply. No published bulk-index download found — index access is per-search only; treat bulk extraction as unsupported.
difficulty_reason: Free but login-gated vendor portal (GovOS/Kofile publicsearch.us); no bulk index; per-doc download fees.
notes: Recorder of Deeds sits under OTR (otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/recorder-deeds; document-images page otr.cfo.dc.gov/service/recorder-deeds-document-images). Recording fees (D.C. Code § 42-1210, OTR fee page): deeds and most documents $31.50; deeds of trust/mortgages and modifications $156.50 (incl. $6.50 surcharge). TRANSFER TAXES: combined transfer (1.45%) + recordation (1.45%) = 2.9% on commercial/mixed-use since Oct 1, 2023, when the temporary 5% combined rate (2.5%+2.5% on commercial ≥$2M, in effect Oct 2019–Sep 2023) expired; residential 1.1% each under $400k / 1.45% each at $400k+ (verify current-year rate on OTR before relying). Non-judicial foreclosure Notices of Default/Sale are recorded here too.

source_name: OTR Real Property Tax Rates page
verification_note: URL appeared verbatim; rate statute code.dccouncil.gov/us/dc/council/code/sections/47-812 and OCFO page cfo.dc.gov/page/tax-rates-and-revenues-property-taxes also confirmed.

Class 3 vacant and Class 4 blighted carry punitive rates (order of $5.00 and $10.00 per $100 — not re-verified this session; check OTR page). Assessed value = 100% of market value, annually.

source_name: Building Permits (annual datasets) — Open Data DC / DOB
verification_note: 'Building Permits in 2025' item URL appeared verbatim; 2023 layer https://opendata.dc.gov/datasets/DCGIS::building-permits-in-2023/about also confirmed. One dataset per year (2017→2026).

source_name: DOB Notices of Infraction (NOI) + DOB Public Dashboard
verification_note: NOI page and dashboard https://dob.dc.gov/page/agency-performance-dob appeared verbatim.
data_format: HTML dashboards; underlying DOB datasets tagged 'dob' on Open Data DC
terms_notes: None noted.

source_name: OTR Annual Real Property Tax Sale (tax-lien sale — DC has no sheriff sale)
verification_note: URL appeared verbatim; 2021-format press release otr.cfo.dc.gov/release/tax-sale-begins-september-20-district-properties-unpaid-taxes and statute code.dccouncil.gov/us/dc/council/code/sections/47-1301 also confirmed.
data_format: PDF/HTML delinquent-property lists (square/suffix/lot order); redemption report on MyTax.DC.gov
update_frequency: annual sale (typically summer/fall); lists published beforehand
cost: free lists; deposits required to bid
terms_notes: Liens (not fee title) are sold. Lists advertised in Washington Post/Times/Current and posted under OTR > Real Property > Tax Sale. Separate annual 'discount sale' of tax-delinquent Class 3 vacant / Class 4 blighted properties.
difficulty_reason: PDF lists keyed by SSL; manual monitoring, no API.
notes: Distress signal for underwriting: subject property appearing on the tax-sale list = delinquent taxes. Post-sale redemption tracked via mytax.dc.gov 'Properties Sold at Tax Sale (Redemption Report)'.

source_name: Mortgage foreclosure records — DC Superior Court case search + ROD-recorded notices
verification_note: Mortgage Foreclosure Sales page and case-search portal https://www.dccourts.gov/superior-court/superior-court-case-search appeared verbatim.
data_format: HTML docket search (document images for some cases)
terms_notes: Anonymous search, no registration. No bulk export.
difficulty_reason: Per-case searching only; non-judicial track lives in ROD records, not court dockets.
notes: DC allows BOTH judicial foreclosure (Superior Court civil complaint) and non-judicial (power-of-sale: Notice of Default, DISB mediation, then Notice of Foreclosure Sale recorded with ROD and mailed to borrower + Mayor 30+ days pre-sale). So check both the court docket AND recorded instruments at washington.dc.publicsearch.us.

source_name: DC Superior Court Landlord & Tenant Branch — eviction case search
verification_note: Case-search URL and L&T Branch page https://www.dccourts.gov/superior-court/superior-court-divisions/civil-division/landlord-and-tenant appeared verbatim.
data_format: HTML dockets; document images for some cases
terms_notes: Anonymous, no registration; no bulk/API access; search by party name or case number only — no address search, so building-level eviction screening means searching the owner/LLC name.
difficulty_reason: No bulk access, no address-keyed search; systematic building-level eviction history requires manual party-name searches.
notes: L&T Branch adjudicates possession (eviction) cases — mostly nonpayment/lease violation. DC has strong eviction-record sealing rules, so older/dismissed cases may not appear.

source_name: DHCD Rental Accommodations Division (RAD) — RentRegistry rent-control database
verification_note: URL appeared verbatim; portal https://rentregistry.dc.gov/welcome-housing-providers/ and dhcd.dc.gov/rentcontrol also confirmed.
data_format: HTML web portal (registrations, exemptions, rent histories)
terms_notes: All DC rental properties must register with RAD (even exempt ones); all filings now via RentRegistry. Public lookup of a building's registration/exemption status and RAD number.
difficulty_reason: Portal lookup, no bulk export.
notes: UNDERWRITE-CRITICAL: Rental Housing Act of 1985 rent stabilization covers pre-1976 buildings of 5+ units absent exemption. Rent-increase caps for rent-control year May 2026–Apr 2027: CPI-W+2% = 4.1% standard; 2.1% elderly/disabled (Rental Housing Commission). TOPA (D.C. Code § 42-3404.02) gives tenants purchase rights on sale of multifamily; RENTAL Act of 2025 (passed Sept 17, 2025) exempts buildings built within last 15 years from TOPA (Notice of Transfer still required). Verify a subject building's registration/exemption in RentRegistry.
